title: You’re Thinking About Exposition All Wrong
skills: analyze how background information is integrated into a story
evaluate effective and ineffective exposition techniques
apply exposition strategically in original narrative writing
alignment_note: Examines exposition as a storytelling tool and challenges overly simplistic approaches to delivering background information. Supports analysis of narrative structure, character and world development, pacing, and purposeful integration of context in literary analysis and creative writing across high school English courses.
